name: A Large Painted Striding Horse
material: Pottery with white slip and mineral colors
summary: Horses were symbols of status and power in ancient China, used for military operations, mobility, and entertainment for the elite. Around the second century BCE onward, pottery horses began to be placed in tombs as status symbols and companions of the deceased in the afterworld. This horse is harnes
